title: 2025/26 Bundesliga 2 stadiums: historic venues that have hosted World Cups, Olympics, Taylor Swift and so much fantastic football | Bundesliga 2
content: Hertha Berlin's Olympiastadion is just one of many iconic stadiums in Bundesliga 2. Bundesliga 2 remains among the best-supported leagues in Europe, and with a number of iconic and otherwise incredible grounds hosting its clubs, the 2025/26 season is sure to see more thrilling football played out against great backdrops. Having been opened for the 1936 Berlin Olympics, the giant stadium moved on from its original association with National Socialism to become a modern venue hosting some of football's biggest events in recent decades. Matches at both the 1974 and 2006 World Cup were hosted there, including the final in the latter tournament as well as the Euro 2024 final, 2015 UEFA Champions League final and a grand total of 44 DFB Cup finals. As well as being Schalke's proud home since its opening, the Veltins-Arena has hosted matches at the 2006 World Cup and Euro 2024, in addition to the 2004 UEFA Champions League final.

content: # German Bundesliga Map. ## Teams. ## Snapshot of the German Bundesliga. The 18-team Bundesliga has the highest average match attendance of any football league in the world. Its average crowd of around 42,000 is roughly 1,000 higher than the Premier League. These high attendances are made possible by relatively low ticket prices and large stadiums, many of which include safe-standing areas. Unlike most other European football leagues, Bundesliga clubs are required to be majority-owned by their members under the “50+1 rule”. This rule limits outside control by investors, including foreign billionaires, although there are some grey areas in its application. **Bayern Munich** are the most successful club in Bundesliga history.
